title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
source: Sick Bits Vol. 14 Matrix By Chris Chappell

ai_review.summary: A superb matrix capture of a monster 1970 set, highlighted by an otherworldly Dark Star, soaring St. Stephen and radiant Turn‑On‑Your‑Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The matrix recording is praised for its spacious, crystal‑clear sound that puts the listener right in the hall, while the performance itself is described as a “monster” with a transcendent Dark Star, flawless St. Stephen → Not Fade Away → Lovelight sequence and inspired Jerry Garcia tones (including his Vox wah).  Overall the show is seen as pure ’70 magic with seamless transitions and an ecstatic crowd.

ai_rating.rationale: Over two dozen reviews overwhelmingly praise both the musical performance (especially Dark Star and other jams) and the matrix recording quality; only a few minor complaints about track breaks, no substantive negatives.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers rave about the spaciousness, clarity and “hall‑effect” of the matrix; one notes original soundboard dropouts but says the matrix smooths them out.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Exploratory mood with seamless transitions (e.g., St. Stephen → Not Fade Away → Lovelight); crowd interaction is highlighted and the set feels like pure 1970 energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his tone, improvisational brilliance, and use of a Vox wah‑wah pedal on Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Keys: Mentioned as “Bobby” adding chordal depth during jams; keyboards noted as building the harmonic texture.
